test_delitem: test deleting a column from a DataFrame using del and verifying it is removed
test_delitem_multiindex: test deleting a column from a DataFrame with MultiIndex columns and verifying KeyError on re-delete
test_delitem_corner: test deleting a column from a DataFrame and verifying KeyError is raised when deleting a non-existent column

test_delitem_single_column: test deleting a single column from a DataFrame and verifying column count decreases
